- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Baja California offers a variety of hiking trails suitable for hikers of all levels, including recommendations for beginners.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended beginner hiking trails include:
  1. Coronado Island: Flat and easy trail with scenic views of the Pacific Ocean.
  2. Cerro El Coronel: Moderate hike with views of Guadalupe Valley's vineyards.
  3. La Sierra de San Francisco: UNESCO World Heritage site with views of ancient cave paintings.
  4. La Bufadora: Easy trail to a popular blowhole with breathtaking ocean views.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is important to bring appropriate gear, plenty of water, and sunscreen when hiking in Baja California.
